findings.text: Message queue audit capture records operation parameters into the calling task audit state and labels the record category for send receive notify and attribute operations, with absent optional timing or notification input normalized to a zeroed representation.

Communication and execution audit capture stores ownership mode and security properties for an object with proposed permissions marked absent, while a separate helper stores proposed size ownership and mode with presence marked, and an execution helper labels the record for program load and stores argument count.

Socket descriptor address mapping and extended open audit capture validates count bounds and storage presence before accepting call data and stores descriptor pairs address bytes mapping association with flags and extended flags mode with resolve controls, allocating address storage on first use when needed.
Tracing audit capture snapshots target thread group identity login identity user identity session identity command label and security properties into the current audit state.

Credential change audit capture chains an auxiliary file capability record holding on disk capabilities with version and effective indication plus old and new sets across inheritable permitted effective and ambient dimensions, and a separate helper stores affected process identity with new sets and labels the category.

Direct log helpers emit records for module load response decisions packet filter configuration abnormal termination restriction events and logging configuration changes, including task identity session command label security context and operation specific response configuration signal architecture or result attributes, skipping one signal induced dump case and disabled paths.

Time adjustment audit state gives precedence to network time data over injected offset data, with injected offset accepted without changing an already set category while any changed network time value overwrites the category and stores the full data set.

Audit capture helpers reject invalid call counts or missing argument storage and report memory allocation failures for address auxiliary or module name storage, with module name loss also recorded through a lost message path and logging helpers returning quietly when no buffer is available.

Observed audit state is partitioned by operation category holding message queue areas, communication ownership and proposed permission areas, execution argument count, call count with argument array, descriptor pair, variable length address with length, tracing target identities, capability sets, mapping and extended open parameters, module name, and time offset or network time data.

Kernel debugger provides overridable architecture hooks for installing and removing software breakpoints reading program counter initializing backend skipping exceptions handling nonmaskable interrupts and notifying secondary processors, with defaults that preserve and patch instruction storage validate by trial install then remove accept empty initialization and forward to per processor entry.

Software breakpoint table entries move between set and active under explicit activation and deactivation passes that skip entries in other states and refresh instruction cache only when safe, reporting install or remove failures while continuing with remaining entries.

Debugger globals start with early mode enabled interactive mode enabled peer notification enabled and active processor single step processor reboot console registration console use and break request indicators in quiescent values, with breakpoint storage initially undefined and coordination counters zeroed, and a boot option can disable peer notification.

Debugger state includes per processor information storage plus global selection for thread in use thread to continue requested switch target single step flag and single step process identity, supporting coordinated entry and mastership handoff across processors.

Debugger registration is guarded by a dedicated spinlock while processor entry coordinates through master and slave mutual exclusion with interrupts held off and read side protection across election quiescence and restore, releasing waiting peers before waiting for their exit and restoring prior interrupt and tracing state on return.

Processor entry distinguishes roles for wanting master acting as slave requesting backtrace and becoming next master, electing one master that quiets peers and runs an interactive loop able to toggle frontends or hand mastership elsewhere, then restores breakpoints hardware state and tracing state before releasing mastership.

Breakpoint address validation can leave memory altered if restoration after trial install fails, which is reported as a severe error, and master entry can proceed after a bounded wait for peers with a severe notice when quiescence does not complete.

Secondary processor notification skips the initiating processor and processors already marked as in progress, marking the flag around an asynchronous request and clearing it on immediate failure, while nonmaskable entry clears the flag and enters as subordinate only when a master session is already active and this processor is not already inside.
Kernel debugger log output uses fixed prefix KGDB for formatted messages.

Audit subsystem defines distinct record categories for message queue communication execution socketcall mapping extended open module response time packet filter abnormal end restriction and configuration change events.
Debugger exposes connection state input output operations table active processor indicator breakpoint setting indicator and thread with single step selection for use across debugger components.

Audit subsystem offers capture entry points for diverse call and event classes that store parameters into current task context or emit formatted records, returning status only where validation or allocation can fail.

Response audit logging encodes subject and object trust as small integers with distinct values for negative affirmative and indeterminate cases, defaulting to indeterminate when detail information is absent.
